protocol.cohort: All 141 validated current pairs, exactly 73 North and 68 South; primary comparison_input BIOs only.
protocol.assignment: Independently in each hemisphere, a uniform permutation without replacement assigns one whole BIO occurrence list to each intact standard/inverted chart pair. Self assignments are allowed.
protocol.binary_statistic: South minus North inversion-win fraction; exact rational ties receive half credit; upper tail >= observed.
protocol.continuous_statistic: South minus North mean(inverted minus standard weighted score); upper tail >= observed.
protocol.scope: New conditional diagnostic using prior conventions, not an exact replay of a prior seed, not the primary endpoint and not new blinded validation.
protocol.assumption: Within each hemisphere, BIO identities are exchangeable over these chart pairs under the reassignment null. This does not control demographic or source-quality confounding.

latitude.protocol: Four prespecified signed-latitude correlations; all score differences are inverted minus standard

limits: Current full-68 coordinates are current captured inputs, not a historical 68-person reconstruction.
No source/time uncertainty is resolved by a passing numerical gate; all subjects remain included.
Two-sided p-values use the classical independent bivariate-normal zero-correlation null.
These four known-cohort reports are not new human validation and have no multiplicity adjustment.

verification_scope.independently_checked_rotation_scope: 11 physical-planet/node longitudes; not every house, angle or proprietary factor.

limits: Known development cohort and retained LLM-generated BIOs; no fresh blinded personality matching or forecasts.

Input policy was frozen before remaining outputs; current source ratings do not certify historical eligibility.
No program settings or birth times were selected to improve agreement with historical keywords.
